capabilities: Track seven media types as Markdown notes with YAML properties
Search metadata providers and create notes from results
Import and sync libraries from Steam, AniList, Trakt and PlayStation
Display cover cards with statuses, ratings and episode or page progress
Build statistics dashboards, custom groups and a release calendar
disambiguation: Not a worldbuilding or lore database; it is a media collection tracker for games, anime, films, series, books, manga and music.
extras: Music library is in beta. PlayStation sync needs desktop authorization and Obsidian 1.11.4+ Secret Storage. Optional online panels (galleries, cast, recommendations, music previews) can be switched off; catalog search and sync keep working.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse and track a media collection with covers, ratings, progress and statistics.

relations.evidence: Browse your Steam library and wishlist, filter played games and recognize titles already in Lorebase before importing.
Select anime and manga from your AniList collection, review progress and see which entries already have local notes.
Review movies and TV shows, watched episodes, ratings and note matches before adding or updating selected titles.
Filter PS4 and PS5 games, review playtime and metadata matches, and select the games to import.

summary: Media library that tracks games, anime, movies, TV shows, books, manga and music as local Markdown notes with cover cards, ratings and progress.
